en.Windows отправляет в Microsoft только об: Windows sends only required diagnostic data to Microsoft, without the optional data.
en.Тот же переключатель, что в Параметрах →: The same switch as in Settings → Privacy & security → Diagnostics & feedback. On Home and Pro this is the lowest level: diagnostics can be turned off completely only on Enterprise and Education. If the level is already lower, Lycoris does not raise it. The option is not offered to Windows Insider Program members — the program needs optional data.
en.Уровень диагностики задан политикой или: The diagnostics level is set by a policy, or this PC is in the Windows Insider Program.
en.Закрепить обязательную диагностику полит: Lock required diagnostics with a policy
en.Тот же уровень «только обязательные данн: The same “required data only” level, but through a group policy — it can no longer be raised from Settings.
en.Нужен, если обновления или программы сно: Needed if updates or apps keep turning optional diagnostics back on. Settings will show “Some settings are managed by your organization” — that is normal for a policy. Undo removes the policy.
en.В Параметрах появится сообщение «Некотор: Settings will show the message “Some settings are managed by your organization”, and the diagnostics level switch will be unavailable until undone.
en.ПК участвует в программе Windows Insider: This PC is in the Windows Insider Program — it needs optional diagnostic data.
en.Политики Windows ограничивают сбор допол: Windows policies limit the collection of extra logs and memory dumps sent to Microsoft.
en.Касается только данных, которые уходят в: Affects only data that goes to Microsoft; crash reports and logs on the PC itself stay. The required diagnostics level does not change.
en.Отключает рекламный идентификатор, по ко: Turns off the advertising ID that apps use to show personalized ads.
Settings → Privacy & security → General. Ads in apps remain, but are no longer personalized.
en.Microsoft перестаёт использовать ваши ди: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data for personalized tips, ads and recommendations.
en.Параметры → Конфиденциальность → Диагнос: Settings → Privacy & security → Diagnostics & feedback → “Tailored experiences”. Does not affect how Windows works.
en.Windows перестаёт собирать и отправлять: Windows stops collecting and sending the history of opened apps, files and websites.
en.Используются официальные политики (Publi: Uses official policies (PublishUserActivities, UploadUserActivities, EnableActivityFeed). Takes full effect after signing out.
en.Windows больше не спрашивает «Как вам Wi: Windows no longer asks “How is Windows?” and no longer asks for feedback.
en.Соответствует значению «Никогда» в Парам: Matches the “Never” value in Settings → Privacy & security → Diagnostics & feedback → Feedback frequency. Feedback Hub still works if you open it yourself.
en.Сайты не получают список языков Windows: Websites do not get the Windows language list for choosing localized content.
Settings → Privacy & security → General. Browsers still use their own language settings.
en.Windows перестаёт собирать примеры рукоп: Windows stops collecting handwriting samples, typed text and contacts for the personal dictionary.
en.Подсказки сенсорной клавиатуры и распозн: Touch keyboard suggestions and handwriting recognition become less personal. Takes effect after signing out.
en.Запрещает Windows и приложениям доступ к: Blocks Windows and apps from accessing the device location.
en.Перестанут работать «Поиск устройства»,: “Find my device”, automatic time zone, weather and location-based maps stop working. On laptops it is usually better to leave it on.
en.Запрещает входящие подключения «Удалённо: Blocks incoming connections for Windows Remote Assistance (msra.exe).
en.Закрывает редко используемый способ удал: Closes a rarely used way to reach the PC remotely. The Quick Assist app keeps working.
en.Запрещает Windows Recall сохранять снимк: Stops Windows Recall from saving screenshots. Snapshots already saved will be deleted.
en.Recall есть только на Copilot+ PC с NPU;: Recall exists only on Copilot+ PCs with an NPU; on other computers the policy changes nothing. Works on Windows 11 24H2 and newer. Undo does not bring back deleted snapshots — it only allows saving them again. Takes effect after signing out.
en.Отключает Click to Do — анализ содержимо: Turns off Click to Do — AI analysis of the screen contents.
en.Есть только на Copilot+ PC с Windows 11: Available only on Copilot+ PCs with Windows 11 24H2 and newer; on other PCs it changes nothing. Takes effect after signing out.
Click to Do appeared in Windows 11 24H2.
en.Отключает в Paint облачные функции ИИ: C: Turns off the cloud AI features in Paint: Cocreator, Image Creator and generative fill.
en.Официальные политики Microsoft (DisableC: Official Microsoft policies (DisableCocreator, DisableImageCreator, DisableGenerativeFill) for all users of the PC. Paint works as before — only the AI buttons disappear, and drawings can no longer be sent from it to a cloud AI service. Officially supported on Pro and higher editions of Windows 11 (22H2 from build 22621.4870, 24H2 — 26100.3360); Paint on Home usually follows the policies too, but Microsoft does not guarantee it. Undo removes the policies. Takes effect after Paint is restarted.
en.Функции ИИ в Paint есть только в Windows: AI features in Paint exist only on Windows 11 22H2 and newer.
en.Отключает в Блокноте инструменты письма: Turns off the Copilot writing tools in Notepad: “Rewrite”, “Summarize” and other AI features.
en.Официальный способ Microsoft — значение: The official Microsoft way — the DisableAIFeatures value in Notepad policies, for all users of the PC. Notepad works as before, only the AI features disappear, and text can no longer be sent from it to a cloud AI service. Works in Notepad 11.2503.16 and newer on Windows 11 after it is restarted. Undo removes the value.
en.Функции ИИ в Блокноте есть только в Wind: AI features in Notepad exist only on Windows 11 22H2 and newer.
en.Служба «Функциональные возможности для п: The “Connected User Experiences and Telemetry” service (DiagTrack) no longer starts automatically.
en.После перезагрузки фоновая отправка диаг: After a restart, background sending of diagnostics does not start on its own. The supported way to reduce telemetry is the “Required diagnostics only” option; the service is an extra measure. The service stays in the system and can be started on demand. Undo restores the previous startup type.
en.Перестанут нормально работать программа: The Windows Insider preview program, some Feedback Hub features and diagnostic tools will stop working properly. Use together with the “Required diagnostics only” option, not instead of it.
en.ПК участвует в программе Windows Insider: This PC is in the Windows Insider Program — it needs the telemetry service.
